title: Squared-off object tumbles into the back pasture at the country house

tellings.quote: this object that was squared off came tumbling across the sky and went into the back pasture behind the house.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber says that in the 1950s, at his family's country house in Texas, a squared-off object came tumbling across the sky and went into the back pasture behind the house. Strieber tells Michels this as something from his own childhood, mentioning a family member, Karl Strieber, and he tells it as an early brush with something unexplained.
